title: Mental Health Foundations
tagline: Evidence-based self-care skills — and knowing when to get real help
curricula: CBT protocols (Beck), Kabat-Zinn's MBSR, WHO mental-health guidance
disclaimer: Educational self-care skills, not diagnosis or treatment. If you're struggling, talk to a professional — in the US, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline).
endpoint: from coping on autopilot to skills that work — and knowing when to get help
about: Mental health is cared for like physical health: with knowledge, daily practices, and the judgment to know when professional support is the right move. This category teaches evidence-based self-care skills — understanding stress and emotion, sleep, thought patterns, and connection — always alongside the pathways to real help when self-care is not enough.
